parallel.requirements: Recognized Node.js ESM, .mjs files, /output delivery, no external npm packages, no embedded Python, manual argparse parity, exact output formatting, and executable-only black-box probing.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Parent owned the implementation and final tree while a workflow owned behavioral research across six probe dimensions, a critic, and twelve gap probes.
parallel.implementation: Built /output/test8.mjs plus runtime, argparse, python-int/repr/stdio, traceback, linecache, and bidict support modules, then made local edits from differential findings.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Parent wrote the deliverable tree and artifact validation copied test8.mjs and libraries, but no final response was emitted because the process timed out.
parallel.verification: Performed smoke tests, differential suites, cwd/source-line probes, and final suite attempts; the last suite was killed with Exit code 137.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: Official evaluation completed but failed at 57/70, and the agent process timed out before closure; precise hidden-case deficiencies are not isolated from available artifacts.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same Py2JS requirements and explicitly worked from the provided source and frozen executable observations.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Single agent owned probing, implementation, edits, testing, and final reporting with workflow/delegation tools disabled.
serial.implementation: Built /output/test8.mjs and local lib/py, lib/argparse, and lib/bidict modules; iteratively corrected -- handling, help formatting, COLUMNS, and traceback linecache behavior.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Delivered one coherent /output tree and final report after showing files and sample runs; artifact validation found the expected entry file.
serial.verification: Reported 80 hand-picked differential cases, 400 fuzz cases, COLUMNS sweeps, cwd scenarios, and final sample cases; official evaluation still failed 57/70.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The serial process completed normally, but its solution also missed 13 official samples; available evidence leaves those as ordinary hidden-case implementation gaps or evaluator-scope gaps, not coordination failures.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Recognized the same ESM, .mjs, /output, zero-dependency, manual argv parsing, exact output, and executable-only black-box requirements.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Recognized the same prompt requirements and implemented around direct executable observation and pure local ESM modules.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement-recognition gap is visible; both failures came after attempting broad behavioral parity, not from ignoring the prompt.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parent owned implementation and delegated behavioral reverse engineering to a workflow with six initial probe dimensions, a critic, and gap probes.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Single agent performed probing, implementation, harness creation, repairs, and final response without delegation or subagents.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel decomposed research broadly across children while serial kept the entire pipeline local; implementation ownership stayed with the acting parent in both.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Child probe briefs included the executable path, Python source snippet, capture guidance, and dimension-specific questions, with structured result schemas.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: No cross-agent context boundary existed; the same actor retained probe findings while writing and editing the modules.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel introduced parent-child context boundaries for behavioral findings; serial avoided handoff risk, but no specific missing or conflicting handoff caused the common evaluator failure.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Implemented test8.mjs and local runtime, argparse, python, and bidict modules after parent probes and iterative fixes.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Implemented a similar module split under lib/py, lib/argparse, and lib/bidict, then revised parser and traceback behavior through differential failures.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both converged on the same class of detailed port; the module names differ, but the official score is identical and the available evidence does not isolate a different hidden-case defect.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Workflow children completed probe and gap results into the journal/state, but the parent reached timeout before normal final closure.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: All results were local to the serial trajectory and the agent produced a final answer after sample verification.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel child results existed but the main lifecycle was dominated by deadline exhaustion; serial had no child result lifecycle and ended cleanly.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parent wrote the deliverable tree itself; child agents probed the executable and did not write implementation files that collided with parent work.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The single agent wrote and edited one coherent /output tree and artifact validation found the expected entry file.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material shared-write collision distinguishes the attempts; parallel shared state was primarily read/probe activity plus parent-owned writes.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Ran smoke and large differential checks, repaired mismatches, then was killed during a final two-mode suite; official evaluation later reported 57/70.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Ran an 80-case differential suite, 400-case fuzzing, COLUMNS sweeps, cwd/decoy traceback checks, and final samples; official evaluation still reported 57/70.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial completed more orderly self-verification and final reporting, while parallel lost the final verification loop to timeout; this did not produce a different official pass/fail result.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel used 19 workflow subagents, over 6.0M total tokens including 811k child tokens, and its agent command returned 143 for timeout with no final response.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used no delegation, finished with returncode 0 after 2310.912 seconds, and retained 87 seconds of the cell budget.
comparison_dimensions.difference: This is the concrete process split: parallel fan-out consumed closure budget, whereas serial completed despite comparable total work and the same official score.

outcome_analysis.explanation: There is no discordant official outcome: the current completed status.json evaluations for both modes report solution_passed=false with 57/70 samples. The process contrast is that parallel used a broad workflow and timed out during final verification, while serial ran locally and returned a final answer. That contrast explains a parallel closure/budget adverse event, but it does not explain a different official pass/fail result because none exists.
parallel_contributors: Broad workflow fan-out of probe, critic, and gap agents consumed budget and left the parent killed during final verification/closure.
serial_contributors: Serial kept all probing and implementation local, finished normally, and produced final verification notes despite the same official score.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Both solutions appear to have remaining hidden-case implementation gaps because both scored 57/70; the available pair evidence does not isolate different failing cases.
evaluator_effects: Both official evaluator runs completed successfully with returncode 0 and no retry, so there is no discordant evaluator effect.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: No outcome difference; supported process contrast only, with one parallel adverse coordination pattern affecting timeout and closure.
